originalSource:
rem Alexandrian Integers
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=221
rem Find the Nth positive integer
rem A = p q r with 1/A = 1/p + 1/q + 1/r

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option N integer = 150000
option Limit integer = 80000

rem Every Alexandrian integer is p q r
rem with q = p + d, r = p + (p^2+1) / d
rem for a divisor d of p^2 + 1 up to p.
rem For p above Limit it exceeds
rem 4 Limit^3, above the Nth value.
Out = array shape (12 * Limit) fill 0
At = 0
for P in 1 to Limit
  Ds = (P * P + 1) divisors array
  Ok' = Ds at most P
  D = Ds filter Ok array
  K = D len
  E' = (P * P + 1) // D
  Vals' = P * (P + D) * (P + E)
  Out (At till (At + K)) = Vals
  At += K
end
Sorted = Out take At sort
Answer = Sorted (N - 1)
Answer print
